mission_prompt: Research recent developments in esp32 and summarize the latest 2026 milestones.

units.description: Perform targeted web searches for ESP32 announcements, datasheets, SDK releases, and industry reports from 2024‑2026. Extract relevant details such as new silicon revisions, feature enhancements (e.g., Wi-Fi 7 support, BLE 5.3, AI acceleration), firmware updates, and ecosystem integrations. Compile the findings into a structured tabular format for downstream analysis.

Using the structured data from t1, produce a concise written summary highlighting the most significant ESP32 developments in 2026. Include key hardware upgrades, software/SDK enhancements, ecosystem partnerships, and any notable industry adoption or use‑case breakthroughs.
